Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly analyze the conflicting search results. The search results explicitly showed two different death locations: one source (Wikipedia snippet in the viewport) stated she died in "Regensburg, Bavaria" on January 18, while another source (Genealogy Online/ThePeerage) stated she died in "Obermais, Meran" on January 20. Instead of flagging this discrepancy and seeking further clarification or verifying the primary source, the WebSurfer incorrectly consolidated the information and proceeded with the "Obermais, Meran" conclusion in subsequent steps, ignoring the clear "Regensburg" citation present in the same search results. This failure to resolve the conflict led to the final answer being based on incomplete verification of the death location.
